bias.en: Uptrend, pulling back · broke $514, testing the $500 area
bias.zh: 上升趋势、回调中 · 跌破 $514，测试 $500 一带

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.8% on Nov 2 to $507.12 (range $504.99–529.63) on 1.5 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($524.30) and 10-day ($526.45) and the rising 30-day ($523.36), and above the rising 100-day ($466.62) and 200-day ($438.18). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($541.29), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 微软 11月2日下跌 2.8%，收于 $507.12（区间 $504.99–529.63），成交量为均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$524.30）和 10 日均线（$526.45）以及上行的 30 日均线（$523.36）下方，位于上行的 100 日（$466.62）和 200 日均线（$438.18）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$541.29），RSI 为 40。

read.en: An early push to $529.6 faded and the close broke the $514.4–515.7 support (Oct 30 and Oct 23 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $514.4–515.7, then $523.4–529.6 (30, 5 and 10-day, Nov 2 high) and $541.3 (SAR, Oct 29 high). Support is $497.3–502.4 (Sep 25–29 lows), then $486 (Sep 10 low) and $477 (Aug 18 low). A close above $516 would target $523–530; below $497, $486.
